zh-CN.title: 系统消息支持多账户独立开关
items: 同一个 WebAPP 内，不同空间账户可分别开启或关闭系统消息
关闭只影响当前账户；重新登录和订阅恢复不会自动打开已关闭的账户

en.title: Independent system notifications for each account
items: Enable or disable system notifications independently for accounts in different spaces within one WebAPP
Turning off one account leaves others connected; signing in again or restoring push keeps opted-out accounts off
